# Spydersoft Identity Provider

Manage clients, API resources, identity resources and scopes on a Spydersoft Identity server through its admin API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    spydersoftidentity = {
      source = "spydersoft-consulting/spydersoft-identity"
    }
  }
}

# All four settings can instead come from the SPYDERSOFT_IDENTITY_URL,
# SPYDERSOFT_IDENTITY_TOKEN_URL, SPYDERSOFT_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID and
# SPYDERSOFT_IDENTITY_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables.
provider "spydersoftidentity" {
  url           = "https://auth-admin-api.example.com"
  token_url     = "https://auth.example.com/connect/token"
  client_id     = "terraform-provider"
  client_secret = var.identity_client_secret
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) client_credentials client with the identity:admin:read/write scopes. May also be set with SPYDERSOFT_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret for client_id. May also be set with SPYDERSOFT_IDENTITY_CLIENT_SECRET.
- `token_url` (String) OAuth2 token endpoint of the identity server. May also be set with SPYDERSOFT_IDENTITY_TOKEN_URL.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the admin API. May also be set with SPYDERSOFT_IDENTITY_URL.
